title: Budget & Finance Support Services
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE THREAT REDUCTION AGENCY (DTRA).DEFENSE THREAT REDUCTION AGENCY
detail_text: This special notice is to inform all interested vendors that, due to recent organizational changes, the Defense Threat Reduction Agency's (DTRA) requirement for budget and finance support services has been unavoidably delayed. Future procurement efforts for these services will be advertised under a new sources-sought notice at a later date. We appreciate your understanding and continued interest.
